title: Add nautical miles across the unit registry and the CLI surface
goal: Add nautical mile (nmi, 1852 m) support to the units module and expose it through the command line, without changing the existing factors.
successCriteria: nmi converts with the exact factor 1852 and renders through the shared formatter
the command line accepts --unit nmi and prints every unit with --list
km and mi keep their current factors and unknown units still fail

nodes.goal: Teach the units module the nautical mile factor and keep the formatter working for it.
nodes.plannedChanges: add nmi 1852 to the factor table in src/units.mjs

nodes.goal: Expose the new unit through the command line surface.
nodes.plannedChanges: add --list to src/cli.mjs and keep --unit validation
